results.title: Procurement Policy
results.text: Every requisition needs human approval before any order is placed. - Up to UGX 500,000: the shop supervisor or the owner may approve. - Above UGX 500,000 and up to UGX 2,000,000: only the owner may approve. - Above UGX 2,000,000: only the owner may approve, and a written justification must be attached. Nobody may approve a requisition they created themselves.

results.title: Reorder Guidelines
results.text: When the budget is limited, restock the most urgent items first. An item is more urgent when its stock is a smaller fraction of its reorder point.

results.title: Procurement FAQ
results.section: Can the AI assistant approve an order if the owner is away?
results.text: No. Approval always needs a person with approval authority. If the owner is away, the supervisor may approve requisitions up to UGX 500,000; larger ones wait for the owner.
